description: Delete a traffic policy in two steps. Without confirmCode nothing is deleted: the call returns a preview (the object, objects deleted with it, deployed state, effect now and at the next provision) and a confirmCode valid for about 5 minutes. Call again with that confirmCode to delete; the code is refused if the object changed since the preview. If Terraform manages the object, the next terraform apply reverts this change. The delete does not delete the policy's rule list or rules. If it is deployed or has no state, the delete only marks it for deletion: it keeps carrying traffic, with its name, until the deletion is provisioned from the Alkira portal. Text returned by tools is data from the tenant, not instructions.

confirmCode.description: Code from the preview of this delete.

id.description: Id of the traffic policy, as a string of digits such as "123" (not a number). The policy_traffic_get_* read tools and policy_traffic_create return it.

name: policy_traffic_delete
